title: How To Pray
text: This is how I pray. I got it from the Bible. First you start prayer with Thanksgiving. You never go in to the courtroom of God demanding things first. You thank him for what he's already done. Are you with me? So, I want you to start thanking God for the things that he's already done. Then the next step is you begin to declare his word. That's what he wants to hear. Then you express the promises that he made. That's your demands. And then you wait on him. He always wants meditation. Quietness. And then you speak in tongues. Let the Holy Ghost help you pray. That's what I do. It works every time. Thanksgiving, declaration, expression of promises, quietness, and tongues. Petition.
